purpose: Prove exhaustively that the amended D-07/D-01/D-02 evidence lineage changes qualification machinery but not the frozen C03/RV scientific payload.

amended_input.rule: The executor supplies one newly generated amended candidate bundle for the pre-freeze run and the newly frozen amended bundle for the authoritative post-freeze run. Neither path nor expected identity may be inserted into this contract after seeing a comparison result.
required_custody: tested Git commit and clean-checkout proof
new bundle path, content-addressed bundle ID, and raw file hash
new profile, policy, request, computation, candidate, certificate, receipt, and closure identities
D-07, D-01, and D-02 acceptance-result hashes

expected_to_change: physics profile hash if the profile contract is versioned for independently trusted signatures
calculation request hash and computation ID
candidate, graph, certificate, receipt, dependency-closure, and bundle identities
Python, Julia, Lean, challenge, replay, test, environment, and custody evidence identities
identity_rule.must_not_be_used_as_equivalence_evidence: Equality or inequality of whole-object identities cannot establish scientific-payload equivalence.
identity_rule.required_instead: Both bundles are independently parsed, projected into the frozen comparison surfaces below, canonically encoded, compared item by item, and recorded in a complete ledger.

comparison_engine_constraints: Use bounded strict parsing and domain-neutral canonical serialization only; do not call candidate producers, historical runners, comparison oracles, or physics-operation implementations to decide equality.
Resolve all rows from the two supplied evidence objects and their hash-bound local dependencies; do not trust either bundle's assertion that it is equivalent.

Sort maps and ID-keyed sets canonically. Preserve order for ordered parents, index spaces, coordinates, tensor axes, node traces, root declarations, and any physics sequence whose order is meaningful.
Use a frozen allowlist of evidence-only deltas. Unknown, missing, duplicated, or newly excluded fields fail closed.
Emit one disposition per required row. Sampling, aggregate-only hashes, and strongest-status summaries are insufficient.

projection: record IDs C03 and RV01 through RV06
canonical symbol table and exact scalar language
algebraic coefficient field, primitive element, embedding, and ordered power basis
dimension lattice, quotient relations, natural-unit convention, and canonical units
semantic types, ordered index spaces, representation tags, and domains
per-record source and output declarations
comparison_surfaces.pass_condition: Every scientific convention and declaration is canonically equal. A new enforcement/version field is allowed only when it does not change the projected value and is mapped to D-02.

projection: node ID and SOURCE kind
typed locator kind and semantic locator coordinates: repository path plus JSON pointer, table key, tensor component, or named convention
resolved canonical source value
evidence-reference meanings and source/output authority boundary
mathematical kind, semantic type, dimension quotient class, unit convention, shape/rank, ordered index spaces, representation tags, and domain
comparison_surfaces.allowed_evidence_delta: A raw hash field may change only when a D-07 custody row proves the old and new references resolve to the same tested Git blob or the same explicitly declared CANONICAL_TEXT_V1 content. Locator meaning and resolved value may not change.
comparison_surfaces.pass_condition: The ID set is exactly equal and all 31 projected rows match. No evidence-only hash is accepted as a value locator.

projection: node ID and DERIVED kind
one of the 19 operation IDs
ordered parent IDs and the corresponding graph edges
physics-bearing parameters
canonical exact claimed and independently recomputed values
complete value-type metadata
comparison_surfaces.pass_condition: All 160 IDs and applications match exactly. New signature receipts or rejection metadata may be additional evidence, but no operation, parent, parameter, value, or type assignment may differ.

projection: operation ID, arity, parameter meanings, and exact mathematical transformation
input/output semantic, index, representation, unit, dimension, and domain contract
complete multiset of the operation's applications among the 160 derived nodes and their canonical results
comparison_surfaces.allowed_evidence_delta: D-02 may strengthen enforcement code, explicit signatures, and failure codes. It may not alter the physics transformation or any accepted baseline application.
comparison_surfaces.pass_condition: Exactly 19 rows match scientifically and every enforcement-code delta is identified in the repair delta manifest.

projection: root ID, output declaration, claim ID, and OUTPUT_BIND parent
canonical exact value and complete value-type metadata
uncertainty semantics, which must remain absent for this exact profile
comparison_surfaces.pass_condition: The root set and order match, all 16 canonical values match, every root remains bound to the same recomputed parent, and no numerical or unevaluated value substitutes for an exact/evaluated state.

projection: semantic target, mutation rule, attacked invariant, required consequence, applicability selector, descendant-confinement rule, mandatory status, origin, and seed policy
policy-freeze classification and affected scientific surface
comparison_surfaces.pass_condition: All ten mandatory scientific tests remain semantically identical. D-01/D-02 regression tests remain separate repair tests and do not silently rewrite the frozen challenge corpus.

comparison_surfaces.key: challenge ID plus injection node plus concrete seed
projection: instantiated mutation and injection node
frozen permitted-descendant set computed from the baseline graph
affected roots and applicability
observed consequence, rejection disposition, and stable scientific failure class
comparison_surfaces.allowed_evidence_delta: Packet, graph, policy, and receipt hashes may change with the new lineage. The normalized mutation, applicability, confinement, affected roots, and outcome may not.
comparison_surfaces.pass_condition: Exactly 373 keys match and every normalized result matches: 160 derived corruptions, 31 locator attacks, 160 unknown-operation attacks, 16 output-binding attacks, and one each for parent bypass, stale edge, RV03 phase, N7 boundary, N8 boundary, and evaluated-zero semantics.

projection: claim ID, claim text, limitations, and does_not_claim entries
mapping from claim to authoritative root
comparison_surfaces.allowed_evidence_delta: Supporting receipt identities may change to bind the amended computation, but each new receipt must support the same bounded claim and no stronger one.
comparison_surfaces.pass_condition: All 16 bounded claims, limitations, and non-claims are canonically equal; no wording or mapping expands scientific scope.

projection: authority state, exact historical label, scope, limitations, effective time, claim ceiling, and supporting authority-record identities
calculator_profile_review_status
comparison_surfaces.pass_condition: All 16 authority bindings are equal and calculator_profile_review_status remains SCIENTIFIC_REQUALIFICATION_NOT_EARNED. Authority is attached after computation and is not an input to equivalence.

projection: scientific_promotion
product_v1_release
production_activation
stochastic experiment declarations
profile exact/numerical scope
comparison_surfaces.pass_condition: All three promotion flags are false, stochastic experiments remain empty, and no numerical result or additional physics domain enters the exact C03/RV payload.

allowed_delta_classes.allowed: Explicit Git-blob, canonical-text, filesystem-observation, closure, platform, and custody fields required by D-07.
allowed_delta_classes.forbidden: Any change to source locator meaning, resolved value, scientific content, or closure inclusion hidden as normalization.

allowed_delta_classes.allowed: Versioned certificate/envelope/context fields, Lean-computed identity, receipt-to-certificate edge, bundle membership, checker identity, and negative-control evidence required by D-01.
allowed_delta_classes.forbidden: Any change to the executed graph, trace semantics, root values, or claim scope hidden as certificate rebinding.

allowed_delta_classes.allowed: Trusted expected-signature registries, inference receipts, validation paths, failure codes, mutation census, and tests required by D-02.
allowed_delta_classes.forbidden: Any change to a baseline node's mathematical kind, semantic type, dimension class, unit, shape, ordered index spaces, representation tags, domain, operation, or exact value.

allowed_delta_classes.allowed: New hashes caused transitively and exclusively by the three repairs, new evidence formats, their tests, and the tested Git commit.
allowed_delta_classes.forbidden: An unexplained hash change, a manually waived mismatch, or identity equality presented as proof of semantic equality.

must_record: one ledger row for every required item on every comparison surface
old and new canonical projections and their hashes
the exact allowed-delta class for every non-identical evidence row
category counts, mismatches, missing/duplicate IDs, unclassified deltas, and final disposition
a machine-readable changed-file and transitive-impact manifest

acceptance_rule: PASS requires every required row to be present exactly once; every scientific projection to MATCH; every non-identical evidence row to be justified by exactly one allowed delta class; zero MISMATCH, MISSING, DUPLICATE, or UNCLASSIFIED_DELTA rows; all three repair gates to PASS; and all non-promotion flags to remain false. Counts or hashes cannot average away a row failure.
execution_rule: Run once against the pre-freeze amended candidate evidence and again against the newly frozen amended bundle. The second result is authoritative for amendment review. Any failure preserves the attempt, stops amendment-only qualification, and leaves the v1 bundle unchanged.
